hero.headline: Headcount doesn't scale.
hero.sub: We build the operational infrastructure that lets established businesses run like an enterprise, without the enterprise cost.

origin.headline: One simple idea.
origin.p1: Bralto started from a pattern I kept seeing in every business I worked with: great products, great teams, healthy margins, but operations that completely depended on people for every single step. A sale lost because nobody picked up in time. A lead gone cold because follow-up came too late. A customer who left for the competitor because the competitor actually answered at 2am.
origin.p2: The problem wasn't a lack of tools. It was the exact opposite: duct-taped tech stacks with 8, 10, 15 different tools that don't talk to each other. CRMs over here, forms over there, half-built automations, broken integrations. Expensive software that ends up costing more in complexity than in licenses.
origin.p3: Bralto was built to fix that at the root. One platform that replaces the entire stack, paired with custom implementations that connect AI, data, and processes into a single system. We don't sell software. We rebuild how the business runs.
origin.statLabel: Years designing automated acquisition and operations systems

items.q: How is this different from a regular website?
items.a: A website only displays information. A system captures the customer, responds to them, follows up, and measures whether they bought. The website is just one piece of the system.

items.q: Do I need to know about technology to use it?
items.a: No. We hand everything over up and running, and your team manages it from a single platform, including from their phones. We will teach you how to use it.

items.q: Will the AI respond well to my customers?
items.a: The agent is trained on your business information: services, prices, hours, and frequently asked questions. When something falls outside what it knows, it hands the conversation to someone on your team.

items.q: How long does it take to be up and running?
items.a: It depends on the scope. After the diagnosis, we give you an exact timeline in writing.

items.q: What if I already have a website or a CRM?
items.a: We review what you already have. If it works, we connect it to the system; if not, we migrate your information to the new platform.
Projects start at $3,500 USD, with financing available. The final price depends on the scope and is defined during the diagnosis.
